remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks note inscription 1 and indicate, "This is probably No. 31 'Grapes No. 1' in O'Keeffe exh. at Intimate Gal, Jan.–Feb. 1928 which lists pictures painted in 1927." Backing inscription dates 1928. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1927. Dated 1927 on basis of inclusion in 1928 New York (Intimate Gallery–O'Keeffe) exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
